pathway: City of Woodland — ADU ordinance conformed to state law (Feb 2026)

citation.source: CEQA Notice of Exemption, City of Woodland ADU Ordinance Amendments (SCH 2026020683), posted 2026-02-19
citation.excerpt: On February 17, 2026, the Woodland City Council adopted an ordinance amending Section 17.84.030, Accessory Dwelling Units, of the City Zoning Ordinance in the Woodland Municipal Code to update regulations for accessory dwelling units (ADUs) and junior accessory dwelling units (JADUs) to conform with state law.

required_documents: City of Woodland ADU application per Municipal Code § 17.84.030
notes: Woodland's ADU regulations were updated February 17, 2026 specifically to conform with current state law — a comparable-jurisdiction precedent (Scenario C): staff in other cities can check their own ordinance's currency against this update. Statutory CEQA exemption under 14 CCR § 15282(h).
